subject: Action Required: Close-date & Stage Lock for Q4 Commit
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Action Required: Close-date & Stage Lock for Q4 Commit

Team —

We need a quick, focused cleanup of open opps tied to the Q4 commit. Finance is finishing the first-pass forecast on Thursday and we can only carry committed ARR that has tight close-date and stage validation. Please review and update the opportunities you own by EOD Tuesday (Dec 8). Specific asks: 

- Confirm close date (move out if not realistic; include rationale in the SFDC notes).
- Set stage to the correct commit level (Commit / Best Case / Upside) and add a one-line reason.
- Remove or tag stale opps (no activity in 60+ days) as "stale — needs follow-up".

I attached a quick export (stale_opps_20261205.csv) filtered to opportunities with inconsistent dates/stages and the forecast_template_q4.xlsx if you want to paste a clean table back. Finance will use the commit bucket on Friday morning for the official forecast.

If any deals are blocked by procurement/legal, call that out and we can decide whether to move to "Best Case" for this cycle. If you think an opp should remain committed despite a >2 week risk, please ping me with the short reason.

Thanks — two small things will keep the forecast accurate for leadership this week.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: stale_opps_20261205.csv (spreadsheet stub), forecast_template_q4.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks Tessa — I'm on it. Quick notes: 

- ACME-9876: Jared told me procurement expects a PO by Friday but legal sign-off is pending. I'll move this to "Commit" with a short note "PO expected 12/10 pending legal" and keep the close date at 2026-12-10 as discussed.
- BETA-421: I will move the close date two weeks out; no engagement in 45 days and the champion is out until Jan.

I'll update the CSV and drop a short comment on each opp. Expect my list by EOD Tue.

Ben

I'm flagged on two deals where legal has pushed review into next week (vendor NDAs + IP addendum). Those are: ACME-1122 and ZENDO-309. For ACME-1122 procurement is asking for custom terms that Legal is still redlining. I recommend we: 

- Move both to "Best Case" for the Q4 commit (they may still close, but not enough evidence to commit).
- Add a one-line note in SFDC with the blocker and expected next touch date.

If Finance insists on keeping them in commit I need a clear escalation path — I don't want to over-commit the number. Happy to discuss on the sync.

Thanks all — short summary and next steps: 

- Ben: update ACME-9876 note to include "PO expected 12/10 pending legal" and keep as Commit for the forecast run.
- Neha: move ACME-1122 and ZENDO-309 to Best Case and note the legal blocker; we'll exclude them from the committed bucket.
- Marcus: send the 30-minute scrub invite (8:30am PT tomorrow) and paste top-10 questionable opps in the invite body.

Deadline reminder: please complete updates in SFDC by EOD Tue Dec 8. Finance will pull the commit bucket on Friday morning (Dec 9) for the leadership forecast deck. If anything changes after your update, flag it in the deal notes AND post a short message in #forecast in Slack so we don't miss it.

I'll run the commit list on Friday and follow up with a one-slide summary for the exec call. Appreciate the quick action — small hygiene win will make the forecast reliable.

— Tessa
